obj/the-notice.text: The notice, pinned in the coach shelter: "Four nights ago the bay floor rose, and something came up with it onto the new flat. Since then Wrackham walks out to it in its sleep, and three have not come back. One of them is my son, Davey Coyle. I will pay whoever finds out what is happening here and stops it before it gets worse, and brings my son home. Ask at the Harbour Office. Wenna Coyle, harbourmistress."
